name: Sara Aykroyd
source: She is the daughter of the president of the biggest car manufacturer in the UK. She was born from the mistress, so she was shunned by her relatives. Her father enrolled her in the monastery school because she was a delinquent. She also loves her younger sister Mariella with all her heart.
